body:
Founder real-time: "pretty sure the bots arent showing up in queue yet
maybe the model will fix it just sayin." Found the real, live, currently-
active cause: bot_think's own heuristic health estimator (a pre-S459-44
relic) was still running every tick, immediately overwriting the real,
server-authoritative health S459-44 wired in. The heuristic almost always
won the race, keeping bots convinced they were near-death, causing a
permanent fake retreat state with unbounded dead-reckoning drift --
confirmed live via a standing bot logging "retreating: hp=14
nearest=8296.1" for minutes. Removed the stale heuristic. Live-verified:
redeployed, zero retreat-spam in 20+ seconds, all 3 bots active and
stable per server STATUS.

Commit: SHANKPIT@5bb2575.

⚓ ☃
title: S459-55: fixed a real bug where bots got stuck in fake retreat and drifted thousands of units off-map
